title: Make the cutting apparatus itself retrievable
statement: Rejected circular saw arbor collided. Proposed thin reciprocating cassette uses actual Bahco3906 300x13x.65mm bimetal stock, U-frame entering with one blade end open, then tensioned/closed for cutting and reopened for retrieval. If end pin seizes, detension and remove its separately bolted end cartridge. Introduced20mm stroke/5Hz/<=50N resultant/300–600s cut/500N tension/guarded>=.1J blade-frame energy and captured chips/pieces/end hardware. Blade availability supplies neither powered cassette, simultaneous force/time, life nor full route fit.
